# Entry Gate

⚠️ **Trading warning / Avertissement trading** : informational only, not investment advice. This gate recommends research only: it never sizes a position, never places a trade and opens nothing. Curated by Skill Harbor: the cheap first filter of the clawock desk, run once per candidate name before any expensive deep research is spent on it. It answers a single question, is this name understandable and researchable enough to proceed, and it grades information richness (A, B or C, from the source classes you cite) separately from investment quality, because a poorly documented company is not the same thing as a bad one. Four hard vetoes are resolved before any check is counted: integrity or governance problems, an unintelligible revenue mechanism, persistent negative cash generation, and destructive dilution, the last two carrying narrow encoded exceptions for specific sectors such as clinical-stage biotech. You supply findings and evidence; the verdict itself (pass_to_deep_research, reject, or gray_needs_evidence) is computed by the packaged clawock command, and a verdict you state that disagrees with the computed one is treated as a validation error, not an opinion. Checks cover business quality, moat, management and governance, valuation, dilution and downside, each pass or fail carrying evidence, and a leveraged ETF takes a different path (underlying exposure, decay and regime, sizing limit, liquidity) because it has no company fundamentals to grade.
